# Classifyre

> Open-source data governance platform you run on your own infrastructure. Control who sees what — enforced on every query. Built in Austria to European privacy and security standards, deployed by organisations across Europe, North America, and worldwide. Apache-2.0.

Classifyre is 100% open source under Apache-2.0 with every capability included (SSO, roles, row filters, dynamic column masking, SQL/BI gateway, dataset requests, shared data products, audit logging, Docker image, and Kubernetes/OpenShift Helm chart). There is no gated enterprise edition. Organisations that want help tailoring Classifyre to their IAM, security architecture, custom sources, Delta data products, or bespoke detectors and AI models can contact our team directly at contact@classifyre.com.

## End-to-end capabilities

1. **Integrate & detect**: Connect 40+ known sources (PostgreSQL, MySQL, Databricks, ODBC, Iceberg, Delta, Parquet, S3/Azure/GCS, wikis, tickets) or custom connectors in place — without replacing existing ETL pipelines. Built-in PII and secret packs plus custom business detectors from regex and Python rules to lightweight local CPU AI models (GLiNER2, text/image classification) and LLMs.
2. **Group-based governance**: Integrates directly with Entra ID, Active Directory, Okta, or any OIDC/SAML directory. Permissions apply to groups with expiration dates, named owners and stewards, owner-approved access requests, and row-level security per department or region. Admins do not get unmasked values by default.
3. **Multi-level column & row masking**: Mask sensitive columns as redacted, last-four, deterministic hashed pseudonymisation (joins and distinct counts still work), empty, or hidden — enforced inside the query engine on both original source tables and shared datasets, with different clearance levels for different groups.
4. **Governed SQL, Power BI, Excel & ODBC**: Standard PostgreSQL-compatible TLS endpoint with personal, expiring, revocable connections for Power BI, Excel, Tableau, DBeaver, and ODBC/JDBC clients, plus AI agents over MCP inheriting the user's own permissions.
5. **Self-service dataset requests & Delta data products**: Business users request combined datasets in plain language or via structured workflows. Owners review and publish live or Delta shared data products that automatically inherit source masking and classification rules as a strict floor.
6. **Complete audit trail & quality**: Every read, export, grant, and approval is logged with user and tool. Scheduled data quality checks and open data contracts (ODCS) support GDPR, NIS2, DORA, and internal audits.

## Deployment

- Self-hosted via Docker (all-in-one evaluation container) or Helm chart for Kubernetes and OpenShift.
- Runs on-premises, in private clouds, air-gapped networks, or AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud.
